Terra has developed and patented the technology of measuring wall thickness using drones. Our services also include visual and thermal inspections. The collected inspection data by the drone is shared via a cloud-based 3D-model of the inspection object, which the client gets access to.  

Using drones for inspections has various advantages. Firstly, the safety-aspect of the inspection get maximized. For example, there is no more need for working at heights. Secondly, the efficiency improves. The downtime significantly gets reduced when preforming inspections with drones. Finally, the collection of data improves in quantity and quality. 

Terra Inspectioneering delivers certified inspection reports conformant to standards like API-653 and EEMUA-159.

Name: Humanoid Application Center
Description:
Humanoid Application Center (HAC) is de Nederlandse werkplaats voor humanoid robotica. Bij MICS in Schiedam, op een vloer van 600 m2, ontmoeten industrie, onderwijs en partners de eerste generatie productie-humanoids. Geen showroom, geen slideware. Een plek waar bedrijven leren hoe ze deze technologie inzetten op echt werk.
HAC is in 2026 opgericht door drie oprichters die elkaar vonden rond één observatie: de eerste golf humanoids wordt niet gewonnen door wie de beste robot koopt, maar door wie als eerste leert hoe je werk, veiligheid, data en adoptie eromheen organiseert.
Richard Kuijpers brengt de hardware. Oprichter van Smartrobot.Solutions en sinds 2013 actief in robotica, officieel distributeur van Unitree, UBtech en EngineAI voor Nederland en België, bouwer van de zorgrobot Maatje. Hij onderhoudt het robotpark en de leveranciersrelaties van HAC.
Evert Jaap Lugt brengt de plek. Host op de Schiedam-locatie, eigenaar van de fysieke campus-context binnen MICS, trekker van rondleidingen en sectorpartnerships. Iedere woensdag- en vrijdagochtend op de vloer voor partners en bezoekers.
Bart van der Werf brengt de implementatie. Co-founder Sherpa Digital, vertaalt techniek naar uitvoerbare proposities, programma's en concrete use cases bij industriële opdrachtgevers. Verantwoordelijk voor klantontwikkeling, partnerships en het Branded Studio-programma.
Wat HAC daarmee biedt is een combinatie die in Nederland nog niet bestond: hardware-onafhankelijk advies, een werkende werkvloer voor training en demo, en een implementatie-partner die meegaat naar de werkvloer van klanten. Vier ingangen: leren, support, kopen, een eigen Branded Studio.
Officiële opening 2 juli 2026. Iedere woensdag- en vrijdagochtend tour op afspraak.

Name: The Hybrid Intelligence Centre
Description:
Hybrid Intelligence (HI) is the combination of human and machine intelligence, expanding human intellect instead of replacing it. HI takes human expertise and intentionality into account when making meaningful decisions and perform appropriate actions, together with ethical, legal and societal values. Our goal is to design Hybrid Intelligent systems, an approach to Artificial Intelligence that puts humans at the centre, changing the course of the ongoing AI revolution.

By providing intelligent artificial collaborators that interact with people we strengthen our human capacity for learning, reasoning, decision making and problem solving. This interaction has the potential to amplify both human and machine intelligence by combining their complementary strengths. Hybrid Intelligence requires meaningful interaction between artificial intelligent agents and humans to negotiate and align goals, intentions and implications of actions. Developing HI needs fundamentally new solutions to core research problems in AI: current AI technology surpasses humans in many pattern recognition and machine learning tasks, it falls short on general world knowledge, common sense reasoning, and human capabilities such as collaboration,  adaptivity, responsibility and explainability (CARE).

The Hybrid Intelligence Centre is a collaboration of top AI researchers from the VU Amsterdam, the University of Amsterdam, the TU Delft, and the Universities of Groningen, Leiden, and Utrecht, in areas such as machine learning, knowledge representation, natural language understanding & generation, information retrieval, multi-agent systems,  psychology, multimodal interaction, social robotics, AI & law and ethics of technology. The HI centre will create a national and international focus point for research on all aspects of Hybrid Intelligent systems.

Name: Gobotty
Description:
Moeite om je logistieke processen efficiënt te laten verlopen? Worden repetitieve taken nog steeds handmatig uitgevoerd ondanks het tekort aan personeel? Wist je dat de aanschaf van een heftruck duurder is dan de inzet van een AMR robot?

Ontdek hoe robotisering met Gobotty veel voorkomende problemen binnen de logistiek en productie oplost. Bij Gobotty zijn we ervan overtuigd dat robotisering niet slechts een product is; het is een innovatieve dienst, die bedrijven vooruit brengt door hen te voorzien van op maat gemaakte robotiseringsoplossingen op basis van een abonnement.

Een Gobotty is te personaliseren op basis van jouw logistieke vraagstuk. Denk hierbij aan toepassingen met rollenbanen, transportbanden, smartmovers, karakuri en klantspecifieke oplossingen.

Of het nu gaat om het transport van pallets, dozen, kratten en stukgoederen, de aanvoer van karton bij inpakstraten, de afvoer van overtollig materiaal en reststromen, of het aan- en afvoeren van tooling en bewerkte producten – voor elk logistiek proces is een module beschikbaar.

Het unieke aspect van Gobotty is dat bedrijven, een complete oplossing huren in plaats van alleen een robot aan te schaffen. Deze aanpak wordt gepresenteerd als “Robotisering as a service”.

Daarnaast zijn onze robots modulair, flexibel en geschikt voor verschillende toepassingen, waardoor ze passend zijn voor elke fase van een organisatie. Gobotty is meer dan alleen een product; het is een innovatieve dienst die bedrijven vooruit helpt door op maat gemaakte robotiseringsoplossingen te bieden.

Name: Olivabot
Description:
Olivabot is building bio-inspired robots to automate olive harvesting in traditional groves.

Millions of olive trees across Southern Europe are grown on steep, rocky, and irregular terrain — making them incompatible with current mechanized harvesters. As labor shortages worsen, more farmers are forced to abandon or under-harvest their groves, threatening both yields and the cultural heritage of traditional olive oil production.

We’re developing terrain-adaptive, AI-powered harvesting robots that can navigate these complex environments — climbing, detecting, and picking olives with precision. Designed for small-to-medium farms, our robots reduce labor needs while preserving the quality and sustainability of hand-picked harvests.

We operate on a Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) model: farmers pay per harvest, with no upfront cost. Our pricing aligns with farmer success, making advanced automation accessible without risky investment.

Why now?
Advances in robotics, computer vision, and lightweight design make it possible to bring automation into places that machines have never gone before. And the urgency is real — traditional groves are being left behind in the global shift to ag-tech. We're here to change that.

Backed by the Amsterdam Academic Angel Fund and supported by Demonstrator Lab (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam), we are currently focused on R&D and early field validation across Italy, Greece, Spain, and Portugal.

We’re not building robots for factories. We’re building them for the hills.

Dat betekent onder meer het voorkomen van verspilling van meststoffen, water, voedingsstoffen en andere hulpmiddelen. In combinatie met het personeelstekort vraagt dit om de inzet van robots. Een consortium van bedrijven en Noord-Nederlandse kennisinstellingen, onder leiding van TNO, richt zich daarom op de ontwikkeling, levering en gebruik van agrobots in de land- en tuinbouw. Het DigiAgro consortium bestaat uit de bedrijven ABDrone, Batenburg-Beenen, Croptimal, Demcon, GroeNoord, Track32 en de kennisinstellingen TNO (projectleiding), Hanze, NHL Stenden, RUG en Saxion.

Description:
De markt voor AI, data en robotisering groeit explosief. Veel oplossingen blijven hangen in beloftes, pilots of losse technologieën. Syntar kiest bewust een andere route.

Wij ontwikkelen slimme, generieke softwareoplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Onze kracht ligt niet alleen in wat technisch mogelijk is, maar in wat operationeel betrouwbaar is. We combineren AI en dataverwerking met robuuste softwareontwikkeling voor robotica. Niet als experiment, maar als toepasbare oplossing in samenwerking met eindgebruikers en publieke partners.

Syntar ontwikkelt. Integreert. Levert.

Name: HB Nexus
Description:
HB Nexus is an optimum and professional solution for the interior washing and disinfection of refrigerated trailers and shipping containers. This innovative automatic machine ensures controlled disinfection thanks to the rigorous application of the disinfectant product in line with concentration, quantity and reaction time requirements for each transport fleet. A powerful high-pressure system allows the equipment to thoroughly clean the interior of up to 16 metres long trailers and up to 45'ft containers, washing away all the dirt. 

Developed and patented by HB Group the HB Nexus is the ideal system for a safe and effective interior wash and disinfection of refrigerated trailers and shipping containers. 60% cleaning time reduction versus manual wash processes, better control of chemical products, top performance and a sturdy design are some of the defining features of this model. The equipment consists of a fixed base, with an elevator platform or with lateral movement as an option, and can be installed outdoors or on a wash bay.

This revolutionizes the cleaning of the loading space of trucks through speed, predictability, cleanliness, sustainability and certifiability

Here are the most important facts:
- Significantly faster cleaning
- Certificate of cleanliness according to HACCP protocol
- Less water consumption
- Less chemistry
- More sustainable 
- No need for staff
- Interface with our cloud and booking system Nuvix

Description:
Welcome to CybaNorth! We are a dynamic team of around 15 passionate students from the University of Groningen, Hanzehogeschool, and UMCG in the Netherlands. United by our shared enthusiasm for technology, we are committed to driving impactful advancements in prosthetic innovation.

Our mission at CybaNorth is clear and ambitious: to empower lives through the development of cutting-edge and affordable prosthetic technology. Embracing diversity and interdisciplinary collaboration, we bring together students from various fields such as Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Human Movement Science, and Physics. We believe in the transformative power of co-design, harnessing the unique perspectives and expertise of each team member.

For those unfamiliar with Cybathlon, it is a pioneering competition that showcases the incredible potential of human-machine collaboration. Participants with amputations or congenital malformations take on tasks reflecting daily life challenges, pushing the boundaries of prosthetic technology and highlighting human resilience.

If our mission resonates with you and you are interested in joining our team, supporting our cause, or learning more about what we do, please do not hesitate to reach out to us (cybanorth@rug.nl). We look forward to connecting with you!

Description:
At MoltenForge, our mission is to empower human-robot synergy while ensuring that autonomous systems serve society safely and ethically. We envision a natural way to control and supervise robots that harness the benefits of robot autonomy without compromising human authority.

To achieve this balance, we develop enabling technologies that blend the best of robot autonomy with seamless human control. Think authoritative frameworks and intuitive interfaces leveraging:

- Visual dashboards and immersive feedback systems
- Teleoperation to control robots from any distance, especially crucial in hazardous or hard-to-reach environments
- Tools and guardrails to ensure humans can intervene when needed and set the boundaries for robot behaviour

Based in Leiden, The Netherlands, MoltenForge is committed to bringing teleoperation technology into real-world applications, enabling meaningful work with robots. We are eager to collaborate with partners who share our passion for advancing human capabilities through robotics and who are inspired to innovate alongside us.

Name: ROX Automation
Description:
ROX Automation specializes in open source software and integration/development services for robotics. Our aim is to make advanced robotics technologies ready for production, affordable, and accessible, focusing on sustainable solutions in agricultural robotics. We are committed to open-source, actively contributing to and sharing within the community to foster innovation. Our approach to open architecture ensures easy integration and reliability in automation. We offer full-stack robotics expertise, from mechanical design and electronics to software architecture and cloud deployment, providing the necessary support for our clients to achieve their goals.



What We Offer

1. Software for Smart Machines: Our focus is on creating software for robotics and automation. This ranges from basic motion control to advanced image processing and custom RTK-GPS guidance systems. Using open-source projects as our foundation speeds up development, allowing us to provide high-quality, ready-to-use software to our customers. We're also committed to contributing back to the open-source community.

2. Integration and Development Services: We offer more than just software. Our services span all aspects of automation technology. We're here to assist you from the first idea to the launch of your product, excelling in transforming concepts into demonstrators and initial commercial prototypes. With our partners, we deliver comprehensive support, including mechanical design, electronics, and firmware development.

Name: LightForce B.V.
Description: LightForce is a Dutch autonomy infrastructure company strengthening the foundation of unmanned systems. As UxS applications scale, developers and operators face a persistent trade-off between closed ecosystems that limit adaptability and open stacks that require heavy customization to achieve reliable, validated performance. This dynamic often concentrates effort on integration and revalidation rather than advancing operational capability. LightForce provides a modular autonomy platform built for developers that modernizes and future-proofs existing systems while supporting interoperability and continuous upgradeability. By enabling clean integration of new sensors, algorithms, and communication layers, LightForce helps its partners accelerate safe and scalable deployment, allowing teams to shift their focus from maintaining fragmented architectures toward delivering resilient, real-world autonomy.

Name: Team Zappp!
Description:
We are Zappp! We are an FTC robotics team from Eindhoven.

Our team was founded in 2019 as an initative by the Tech Playgrounds. 2019 also marked the first season we took part in where we ended second in the Dutch national finals.
During Covid-19 we had a rough couple of years due to not being able to get together.
However, the 2022-2023 season marked our comeback as one of the only "independant" FTC teams (we're not owned by a school).

The FIRST Tech Challenge, or FTC for short is a international competition organized by FIRST to encourage technological research by teenagers and young adults. You may have heard of the FLL and FRC, these are similar competitions organized by FIRST. In the FTC every team gets a set of the same challenges which they have to solve through robotics and automation, your team then plays a number of alliance battles to put your robot to the test.

In FTC your team designs, builds, programs and tests an entire robot from scratch. Next to all off that teams are required to raise funds to build their robot, market their team, reach out to the community and a lot more.

Together, we identify opportunities where robotics can create value. Whether it's a flexible, multi-purpose robot or a targeted, single-purpose solution, we turn your idea into a functional reality. From 3D modeling to a fully deployable prototype, we guide and support every step of the process.

Our goal is to support safer, more transparent, and more reliable robot operation in research and industrial environments.
